decision.thought: Tera Grass Wood Hammer: Banded, STAB and super effective, it should KO Krookodile even through the Intimidate drop. Tera Grass also turns its Earthquake from super effective to neutral, so Sudowoodo survives the hit and trades cleanly.
decision.notes: Tera used (Sudowoodo Grass). Opp Krookodile has Intimidate. Sudowoodo is Band-locked into whatever move it picks.

decision.thought: Sudowoodo is Band-locked into a resisted Wood Hammer at -1, so it has nothing left against Chi-Yu. Oricorio comes in on the likely fire move and threatens Quiver Dance plus Hurricane.
decision.notes: Tera used (Sudowoodo Grass, band-locked into Wood Hammer, 87%). Opp Krookodile fainted (Intimidate, EQ). Chi-Yu lvl77 Beads of Ruin, moves unknown; watch for Psychic, Dark Pulse, or Tera Rock/Electric on Oricorio. Conkeldurr Mach Punch is super effective on Chi-Yu.

decision.thought: Oricorio should outspeed an unboosted Chi-Yu, and Hurricane is our strongest neutral hit, likely taking around half its health. Oricorio can probably survive one more resisted Fire Blast or even a Dark Pulse, so we get two swings at it.
decision.notes: Chi-Yu lvl77 Beads of Ruin, Fire Blast did 36% to resisted Oricorio, so possibly Specs or a Nasty Plot set. Speed estimate ~199 vs our Oricorio 204, but Scarf is possible. Conkeldurr Mach Punch and Mimikyu Drain Punch are backup answers. Sudowoodo is locked into Wood Hammer (Tera Grass used).

decision.thought: Oricorio is at 13% and can't survive another Dark Pulse, so it swings Hurricane for maximum chip. Revelation Dance would be Fire-type and resisted. If Hurricane lands, Chi-Yu drops to about 10% and Conkeldurr's Mach Punch can clean up on the free switch.
decision.notes: Chi-Yu lvl77 Beads of Ruin with Fire Blast and Dark Pulse. Oricorio outsped it, so it's likely not Scarf. Dark Pulse did 51% to Oricorio, and Hurricane does about 45% to Chi-Yu. After Oricorio faints, bring Conkeldurr and use Mach Punch to finish. Mimikyu with Disguise and Drain Punch is the backup answer. Sudowoodo is Tera Grass, Choice Band, locked last into Wood Hammer.

decision.thought: Chi-Yu is at 8%, so Conkeldurr comes in to finish it with Mach Punch. The priority move is super effective against Dark and works even if Chi-Yu doesn't attack, unlike Sudowoodo's Sucker Punch.
decision.notes: Chi-Yu lvl77 at 8% with Beads of Ruin, Fire Blast and Dark Pulse, probably not Scarf. Plan: Mach Punch with Conkeldurr now. Krookodile is already down. Sudowoodo has Sucker Punch as a backup and is at 248/284. Mimikyu is intact with Disguise. Slaking is Choice Band with Truant.

decision.thought: Chi-Yu is at 8% and faster than us, so priority Mach Punch finishes it before it can fire off a Fire Blast. Fighting is super effective on Dark/Fire, so this is a clean KO.
decision.notes: Chi-Yu lvl77 has Beads of Ruin, Fire Blast and Dark Pulse, and should be KO'd by Mach Punch. Krookodile (Intimidate, Earthquake) is fainted. Conkeldurr is Guts with Flame Orb and Tera Normal. Sudowoodo is at 248/284 with Sucker Punch as a backup. Mimikyu still has Disguise up. Slaking is Choice Band with Truant. Drifblim (Unburden, Calm Mind) is a possible late-game win condition.

decision.thought: Tera Normal turns burned Guts Conkeldurr's Facade into a STAB nuke. That should OHKO Thundurus-T from 88%. The burn is already active, so there's no reason to hold back.
decision.notes: Conk now Tera Normal (if used), burned Guts, Facade main STAB. Chi-Yu at 8%, Mach Punch picks it off (neutral now vs Dark/Fire? Fighting still SE on Dark... Fire neutral). Thundurus-T likely Nasty Plot/Tbolt/Focus Blast/Grass Knot/Volt Switch; it outspeeds Conk. Opp has 3 unrevealed mons. Drifblim is the late wincon, and Slaking is Choice Band Truant.

decision.thought: Sudowoodo comes in to handle Tera Flying Thundurus. Rock resists its Flying Tera Blast, and a Choice Band Head Smash should OHKO it through Flying's Rock weakness. Sudowoodo should survive one unboosted Thunderbolt or Grass Knot first.
decision.notes: Thundurus-T Tera Flying (Tera Blast Flying, probably special Nasty Plot set), 88%. Chi-Yu at 8%: Sucker Punch or Mach-speed priority picks it off. Sudowoodo Choice Band: Head Smash into Thundurus, Sucker Punch for Chi-Yu. Slaking Tera Ground available. Drifblim is the late wincon. 3 opponent mons still unrevealed.

decision.thought: Banded Head Smash off Sudowoodo is super effective on Tera Flying Thundurus and should easily one-shot it. Rock Head means no recoil, so the main risk is the 80% accuracy. Thundurus outspeeds, but Tera Blast may not quite finish us from 87%.
decision.notes: Sudowoodo is already Tera Grass, so our Tera is used. Thundurus-T is Tera Flying with Tera Blast. Chi-Yu at 8% can be picked off with Sucker Punch or Mimikyu's Shadow Sneak. 3 opponent mons still unrevealed. Drifblim is the late wincon, and Slaking cleans up.

decision.thought: Slaking comes in to face Thundurus-T. At about 216 Speed it should outspeed a non-Scarf Thundurus (~208), and a banded Double-Edge should KO it from 88%.
decision.notes: Thundurus-T is Tera Flying with Tera Blast, estimated ~208 Speed and ~258 HP. Plan is Slaking Double-Edge now, which leaves Slaking loafing a turn. Chi-Yu at 8% dies to Mimikyu Shadow Sneak. Our Tera is used (Sudowoodo). Drifblim is the late wincon.

decision.thought: Slaking outspeeds Thundurus-T (216 vs ~208), and Choice Band Double-Edge should comfortably KO it from 88%. I'm taking the guaranteed hit and the recoil over Giga Impact's 10% miss chance.
decision.notes: Opp Thundurus-T is Tera Flying with Tera Blast, ~208 Spe. Chi-Yu is at 8% and dies to Mimikyu Shadow Sneak. Our Tera is used. Slaking loafs next turn after attacking; consider switching then. Drifblim is the late wincon. Opp has 3 unrevealed mons.

decision.thought: Slaking loafs this turn no matter what, but it can soak one hit from Thundurus-T. Next turn it outspeeds at 216 and Choice Band Double-Edge should flatten the frail Tera Flying genie. Switching in now would just waste Mimikyu's Disguise or put Drifblim in front of Electric attacks.
decision.notes: Slaking loafs T9 and attacks T10; it outspeeds Thundurus-T (~208) unless Thundurus has Scarf. Band Double-Edge should OHKO Thundurus-T. Our Tera is used. Opp has 3 unrevealed mons. Drifblim is the late wincon. Mimikyu Disguise is intact.

decision.thought: Slaking's Truant turn is over, so it can attack now. It should outspeed Thundurus-T, and a banded Double-Edge easily covers Thundurus's remaining 88%. The recoil won't knock Slaking out.
decision.notes: Thundurus-T is Tera Flying with Tera Blast and Focus Blast. If it survives or has a Scarf, Slaking dies. Next turn Slaking loafs, so consider sacking it or pivoting. Drifblim is the late wincon, and Mimikyu's Disguise is intact. Opp has 3 unrevealed mons. Our Tera is used.

decision.thought: Slaking loafs this turn at 9% HP and is choice-locked, so it's dead weight. Sacking it gives Drifblim or Mimikyu a free switch-in instead of eating a Scald on the way in.
decision.notes: Opp: Milotic (100%, set unknown, likely Scald/Recover/Haze or Flip Turn) plus 2 unrevealed mons. Our Tera is used. Plan: after Slaking faints, bring in Drifblim to Calm Mind and Strength Sap against Milotic, or Mimikyu to Swords Dance behind its intact Disguise. Watch for Haze on Milotic.

decision.thought: Drifblim comes in on Milotic: a Scald burn does nothing to a special attacker, so it can Calm Mind up and keep its Sitrus Berry to stay healthy. Mimikyu and its intact Disguise stay in the back to clean up later.
decision.notes: Opp: Milotic (100%, Scald revealed, likely Recover plus Haze or Flip Turn) plus 2 unrevealed mons. Our Tera is used. Plan: Drifblim uses Calm Mind against Milotic and attacks with Shadow Ball or Air Slash. Strength Sap heals little off Milotic's low Attack, so save it for physical threats. If Milotic uses Haze, switch the plan to chip damage and keep Mimikyu (Swords Dance behind Disguise) as the closer.

decision.thought: Milotic's Scald barely scratches Drifblim, and a burn doesn't hurt a special attacker. We start stacking Calm Minds, and Sitrus Berry plus Unburden gives us a speed boost later.
decision.notes: Opp: Milotic (Scald, likely Recover plus Haze or Flip Turn) plus 2 unrevealed mons. Our Tera is used. We likely outspeed Milotic (187 vs ~182). Plan: Calm Mind 2-3 times, then Shadow Ball. If Haze shows up, go to chip damage. Mimikyu is the closer with Swords Dance behind Disguise.

decision.thought: Disguise gives Mimikyu a free turn against Milotic, so we Swords Dance now. At +2, a Life Orb Play Rough takes a huge chunk out of it and threatens the unrevealed back line too.
decision.notes: Opp: Milotic (Scald, Dragon Tail, probably Recover), 2 unrevealed mons left. Our Tera is used. Mimikyu: SD, then Play Rough and Drain Punch for sustain, Shadow Sneak to pick off low targets. If Dragon Tail phazes us, Drifblim comes in and keeps up Calm Mind boosting. Watch for Scald burns on Mimikyu.

decision.thought: Mimikyu is at +2 with a Life Orb, so it's time to cash in. STAB Play Rough should take roughly 75-85% off Milotic, which sets up a Shadow Sneak finish next turn.
decision.notes: Opp: Milotic (Scald, Dragon Tail, probably Recover), 2 unrevealed mons. Our Tera is used. Mimikyu is at +2 with its disguise busted. Plan: Play Rough, then Shadow Sneak to pick off low targets. If Milotic Recovers, keep hitting it. If Dragon Tail phazes Mimikyu, Drifblim sets up Calm Mind.

decision.thought: Milotic sits at 27%, and Play Rough just did 79% at +2. Shadow Sneak at the same boost should do about 35%, enough to finish it. It also has priority and can't miss, unlike Play Rough's 90% accuracy.
decision.notes: Opp: Milotic (Scald, Dragon Tail, Leftovers) should fall to Sneak. The other 2 opposing mons are still unrevealed. Our Tera is used. Mimikyu is +2 with its disguise busted, at ~31% after Life Orb recoil. Drifblim (Calm Mind, Strength Sap, Sitrus Berry) is the backup win condition. Use Shadow Sneak to pick off faster threats at low HP.

decision.thought: Dondozo is probably Unaware, so our +2 Attack doesn't matter, and a 31% Mimikyu can't break it. Drifblim comes in to Strength Sap and chip with special attacks against its weaker Special Defense. That keeps Mimikyu alive to Shadow Sneak the 27% Milotic later.
decision.notes: Opp Dondozo (Leftovers), likely Unaware with Curse/Rest/Wave Crash. Plan: Drifblim uses Strength Sap and Shadow Ball/Air Slash on Dondozo; CM boosts don't count against Unaware. Save Mimikyu (31%, +2 lost on switch) to Sneak Milotic (27%). One opposing mon still unrevealed.

decision.thought: Drifblim outspeeds thanks to Unburden. Strength Sap heals us back near full and drops Dondozo's Attack. Unaware ignores our boosts but not its own drops, so this is how we beat it.
decision.notes: Opp Dondozo (Leftovers, Wave Crash does ~48% to unboosted Drifblim), likely Unaware with Curse/Rest. Drifblim's Unburden is active, so it outspeeds. Plan: Strength Sap to stack Attack drops, then Shadow Ball it down. Save Mimikyu (31%) to Shadow Sneak Milotic (27%). One opposing mon still unrevealed.

decision.thought: Oops, Strength Sap set off Competitive, so Milotic is now at +2 SpA. Drifblim still outspeeds and is at full HP. It can take one boosted Scald, so Shadow Ball now and again next turn should finish Milotic.
decision.notes: Opp Milotic has Competitive and Leftovers, with Scald and Dragon Tail; it may have Recover. Do NOT use stat-lowering moves on it. Two Shadow Balls from Drifblim (about 22% each) should KO it from 33%. Dondozo is at 84% with Leftovers and Wave Crash. One opposing mon is still unrevealed. Mimikyu (68 HP) has Shadow Sneak as a backup finisher.

decision.thought: Shadow Ball's 24% can't beat Milotic's Recover, so trading hits goes nowhere. Calm Mind softens its +2 Scalds and builds toward Shadow Balls that out-damage Recover. Drifblim is faster, which lets it set up first.
decision.notes: Opp Milotic has Scald, Dragon Tail, Recover, Leftovers and Competitive, currently at +2 SpA. Plan: stack Calm Minds (2-3), then Shadow Ball. Use Strength Sap only for small heals because Milotic's Atk is low. Dondozo is at 84% with Wave Crash. One opposing mon is still unrevealed. Mimikyu is at 68 HP as backup.

decision.thought: Drifblim outspeeds Milotic, and each Calm Mind cuts its +2 Scalds further. Shadow Ball at +1 only does about 36%, and Recover outpaces that, so we keep stacking before we swing.
decision.notes: Opp Milotic: Scald/Dragon Tail/Recover/Leftovers, Competitive, +2 SpA, about 182 Spe (we're faster at 187). A Dragon Tail would drag in Mimikyu (68 HP) and wipe our boosts. Shadow Ball estimate: about 24% per stage multiplier, so roughly 36% at +1, 49% at +2, 61% at +3. Use Strength Sap (heals ~98 HP from -1 Atk Milotic) if Drifblim is below ~50%. Dondozo is at 84% with Wave Crash. One opposing mon is still unrevealed.

decision.thought: Drifblim is at 33% and one more +2 Scald, especially with a burn, puts us in KO range. Strength Sap heals about 98 HP off Milotic's -1 Attack and drops its Attack again, which keeps us alive to keep stacking Calm Minds.
decision.notes: Opp Milotic: Scald/Dragon Tail/Recover/Leftovers, Competitive, +2 SpA. Its Attack will be -2 after this Sap, so later Saps heal less (~74, then ~59). Its +2 Scald does ~28% into our +2 SpD. Plan: Sap back to ~58%, then Calm Mind toward +4/+5 and break through its Recover with Shadow Ball. Watch for Dragon Tail dragging in Mimikyu (68 HP). Dondozo is at 84% with Wave Crash. One opposing mon is still unrevealed.

decision.thought: Drifblim is at 14% and can't survive another +4 Competitive Scald. Sapping would only feed Competitive to +6, so we outspeed and fire off a +2 Shadow Ball for maximum chip before going down.
decision.notes: Opp Milotic: Scald/Dragon Tail/Recover/Leftovers, Competitive, now +4 SpA. Never lower its stats again or Competitive triggers. Drifblim is likely to fall this turn. Mimikyu (68 HP) is our last mon and faces Milotic plus Dondozo at 84% with Wave Crash, which is very hard. One opposing mon is still unrevealed.

decision.thought: Last mon standing: Mimikyu comes in to face a +6 SpA Milotic at 46%. Disguise should absorb one hit, so we fight for a miracle with Play Rough and Drain Punch pressure.
decision.notes: Only Mimikyu (68/216) is left. Opp Milotic is at 46% with +6 SpA and -1 SpD; its set is Scald/Dragon Tail/Recover/Leftovers. Dondozo is at 84% with Wave Crash, and one opposing mon is unrevealed. Mimikyu outspeeds Milotic. Disguise blocks the first hit. Consider Tera Fairy + Play Rough for damage. Don't lower Milotic's stats.

decision.thought: Our Disguise is already broken and Milotic is at +6 SpA, so any Scald finishes us. It's all-in: Tera Fairy Play Rough with Life Orb should roughly take 49-58% and knock out Milotic from 46%, if the 90% accuracy holds.
decision.notes: Mimikyu is Busted, so Disguise is already used and gone. Last mon: go for maximum damage. Dondozo 84% with Wave Crash, plus one unrevealed opponent.
